title: Marketing hero
intendedUserGoal: Understand the offer quickly and choose the primary next action.

strongFindings.rootCause: The content card, image block, and CTA group compete instead of creating one reading path.
The primary and secondary actions are too close in emphasis for a conversion-led hero.

rootCauseObservations: Unclear hierarchy between message, image, and action is more important than isolated spacing nits.
mergeGuidance: Merge heading, image, and CTA symptoms into one hero reading-path finding when evidence overlaps.
scannerSpamToAvoid: Do not produce separate low-value findings for every rounded corner or decorative shadow.
